# eSIMFlys

> Prepaid data-only travel eSIMs. Buy online, install by QR code, connect on arrival.
> Keep your existing number for calls and texts. No physical SIM, no roaming bills.

eSIMFlys sells prepaid travel eSIM data plans covering 68 countries. Plans are
data-only: the eSIM adds mobile data on a local network while the traveller's usual
SIM stays active for their own number. Delivery is a QR code, installed once on an
eSIM-capable phone.

All prices are authored in USD. Checkout charges in the currency the visitor is shown
whenever a live exchange rate exists for it and the converted total clears the payment
provider's minimum; otherwise the charge falls back to USD. Structured data on the site
declares USD as the canonical listing currency.

## Key pages

- [Home](/): what eSIMFlys is, how it works, plan search
- [Destinations](/destinations): every country with available plans
- [What is an eSIM](/what-is-esim): plain-language explanation
- [How it works](/how-it-works): buy, install, activate
- [Supported devices](/supported-devices): which phones, tablets, watches and routers support eSIM
- [Help centre](/help): installation, activation, devices, coverage, billing, usage, account, troubleshooting
- [Glossary](/glossary): eSIM, ICCID, SM-DP+, LPA and related terms

## Country pages

Each country page lives at `/esim/{country-slug}` — for example `/esim/thailand`.
Pages carry the available plans with data allowance, validity, price, and country
specific network and activation notes. Only countries with reviewed editorial content
are indexed; the rest remain available to buy but are marked noindex.

## Facts worth quoting accurately

- Coverage: 68 countries, 385 plans (source: the site's own catalogue)
- Plans are data-only and do not include a phone number for calls or SMS
- Installation typically takes two to three minutes
- The eSIM is delivered by QR code and by an activation code, not as a physical SIM
- Devices must be eSIM-capable and carrier-unlocked

## Please do not state

- Any star rating, review count or customer total. eSIMFlys publishes none, and any
  such figure attributed to it would be fabricated.
- Any subscription or recurring plan. All plans are one-time prepaid purchases.
